nodes.label: Session start reading order
nodes.rationale: BRAINSTORMING -> CLAUDE.md -> MEMORY -> NOT_DONE -> WORKED_LESSON gives full context in ~6-7 minutes with minimal reads.

nodes.label: End-of-session doc update order
nodes.rationale: After each completed task update DONE, NOT_DONE, PLAN, WORKED_LESSON, TEST, MEMORY, BRAINSTORMING, PACKAGE in that order to keep tracking docs consistent.

nodes.label: Golden rules (EN code / FR docs, mandatory patterns)
nodes.rationale: Strict English code and French docs; mandatory Singleton/Observer/Strategy/Command/State Machine/MVC; no SendMessage, no FindObjectOfType in loops, no StartCoroutine timers (use async/await or GameEvents); ScriptableObjects for all static data; null checks + try/catch on Save/Load; Play Mode tests per heavy system; one system at a time with user validation.
nodes.norm_label: golden rules (en code / fr docs, mandatory patterns)

nodes.label: unity-claude.sh command set (Compile, Build*, Run*Tests, FindAssets, ClearCache, ScanLegacyPackages, AutoMigrate)
nodes.norm_label: unity-claude.sh command set (compile, build*, run*tests, findassets, clearcache, scanlegacypackages, automigrate)

nodes.label: Headless Unity safety rules
nodes.rationale: Always Compile after .cs edits, commit before builds, check claude-output/result.json, TIMEOUT=900 for big builds; never hand-edit .unity/.prefab/.asset/.meta, Library/ or Temp/, and never run parallel Unity instances (lock file).

nodes.label: Divine Interventions (Qi Pulse, Ancestral Shield, Mirror Judgment)
nodes.rationale: Player (the mirror) spends MirrorPower (10/25/50) to buff a combat unit, boost breakthrough success by 30%, or trigger Qi Deviation.
nodes.norm_label: divine interventions (qi pulse, ancestral shield, mirror judgment)

nodes.label: Player as consciousness trapped in ancestral bronze mirror
nodes.rationale: Player controls no character directly; observes, guides and influences a mortal family over generations to become the strongest cultivator clan of Mount Dali.
nodes.norm_label: player as consciousness trapped in ancestral bronze mirror

nodes.label: MVC pattern (data POCOs vs managers vs UI)
nodes.rationale: Only theoretical so far: POCO data separated from managers, but UI logic still lives in MonoBehaviours (NOT_DONE #102).
nodes.norm_label: mvc pattern (data pocos vs managers vs ui)

nodes.label: Code conventions (MirrorChronicles.<Module> namespaces, XML docs, OnEnable/OnDisable subscriptions)
nodes.rationale: Singletons expose static Instance with Awake duplicate-destroy; events subscribed in OnEnable and unsubscribed in OnDisable (never Awake/Start); Debug.Log prefixed with [System]; POCOs [Serializable] with parameterless ctor and Guid IDs.
nodes.norm_label: code conventions (mirrorchronicles.<module> namespaces, xml docs, onenable/ondisable subscriptions)

nodes.label: Key Xianxia business rules
nodes.rationale: 6 realms, min root 0/10/30/50/70/90, breakthrough fail 5-70%, 5 founding members, marriage age 18, incest forbidden up to 3 generations, 4 phases/year, Qi does not regen in combat except ConcentratedQi, Ironman JSON save, 10x10 grid, faction relation -100..+100. Note: DONE.md says MarriageSystem.CanMarry only blocks direct siblings, which conflicts with the 3-generation incest rule.

nodes.label: Memento pattern - save slots (#101)

nodes.label: Unity bootstrap via temporary Universal 2D project merge
nodes.rationale: Repo already had Assets/_Project/Scripts but no ProjectSettings/Packages; create a throwaway Universal 2D project in /tmp and copy ProjectSettings + Packages into the repo so Unity generates .meta files.
